name: query_restaurant
description: The tool searches for a restaurant based on the user's preferences and provided criteria such as type of food, location, and other options.

required_parameters.name: food_pref
required_parameters.description: The preferred type of cuisine or food the user is looking for.

required_parameters.name: loc
required_parameters.description: The location where the user is searching for a restaurant. This can be a specific city or a general area.

optional_parameters.name: open
optional_parameters.description: A criterion to find out if the restaurant is currently open.

optional_parameters.name: parking
optional_parameters.description: A criterion to inquire about the availability of parking at the restaurant.

optional_parameters.name: price
optional_parameters.description: A criterion to determine the price range or cost level of the restaurant.

result_parameters.name: default
result_parameters.description: The default or top result returned from the search query, typically represented by a restaurant ID or name.

result_parameters.name: goals
result_parameters.description: Specifies which information the user is interested in, such as 'price', 'parking', or 'open'.
